gloss: dry rainy season; rainy season with little rain

definitions.gloss: dry rainy season; rainy season with little rain
definitions.explanation: A tsuyu (rainy season) in which far less rain falls than usual, sometimes causing water shortages.

examples.japanese: {今年|ことし}は{空梅雨|からつゆ}だ。
examples.english: This year the rainy season is dry.

examples.japanese: {空梅雨|からつゆ}で{水不足|みずぶそく}が{心配|しんぱい}されている。
examples.english: With the dry rainy season, water shortages are a concern.

examples.japanese: {空梅雨|からつゆ}が{続|つづ}くと{農作物|のうさくもつ}の{生育|せいいく}に{影響|えいきょう}が{出|で}る。
examples.english: A prolonged dry rainy season affects the growth of crops.

notes:
The prefix {空|から}- means 'empty' — the rainy season arrives but brings little rain. Read からつゆ, not くうばいう.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {空梅雨|からつゆ}になる: to turn into a dry rainy season
- {空梅雨|からつゆ}{気味|ぎみ}: somewhat short of rain

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {梅雨|つゆ}: the rainy season — June through July in most of Japan
- {梅雨明|つゆあ}け: the end of the rainy season

cross_references.label: the end of the rainy season
